biblical_reference.note: Hagar is the Egyptian handmaid of Sarah, who is given to Abraham as a wife when Sarah becomes barren. Hagar bears Ishmael to Abraham, and Sarah bears Isaac. Hagar and Ishmael are cast out into the wilderness, but an angel appears to Hagar and promises to make Ishmael a great nation. Later, Hagar and Ishmael return to Abraham and Sarah, and Ishmael is treated kindly.
